messages.subject: RE: FW: Renewal - non-negotiable points before we sign - NEED INPUT TONIGHT
messages.body:
Quick recap of the situation and the options I see:

1. Full offline (what we cut on 2 April): ~6 engineer-weeks. Does not fit before mid-May, full stop.
2. Read-only offline: cached routes and manifests, no edits queued, everything else disabled when offline. Jonas - is that still the ~1.5 engineer-week estimate from the April sizing?
3. Keep the cut and negotiate Bruno down. Risky: Redline is ~18% of revenue and the renewal is the quarter.

Jonas, Dev - I need real numbers before the 15:00 call tomorrow. Thanks!

messages.subject: RE: FW: Renewal - non-negotiable points before we sign - NEED INPUT TONIGHT
messages.body: read-only is the offline branch we parked, minus the hard part. the offline branch already caches routes and manifests; we just delete the queued-edit code path and grey out anything that writes. ~1.5 engineer-weeks, mostly me, ravi can do the ui greying. the sync code is the risk - it was written assuming online-only, so caching + reconnect revalidation needs real testing. doable if nobody touches my sprint for two weeks. fwiw.

messages.subject: RE: FW: Renewal - non-negotiable points before we sign - NEED INPUT TONIGHT
messages.body:
So to be clear: Bruno says "offline" and we are debating shipping a read-only version and calling it offline ✅ I can maybe sell that, but only if it is genuinely useful in a tunnel - routes and manifests visible, driver not staring at a white screen. If he tests it and it feels like a brochure, we lose credibility on the whole renewal.

Can we demo it to him before the pilot? Even a rough build? I need something to put on the table at 15:00 🚀

messages.subject: RE: FW: Renewal - non-negotiable points before we sign - NEED INPUT TONIGHT
messages.body:
Summary for the 15:00 call:

- Full offline: ~6 engineer-weeks, pushes everything out again. No.
- Read-only offline (cached routes + manifests, no edits): ~1.5 engineer-weeks, Jonas confirms. Fits between now and the rollout window if it starts next week.
- It is honest to call it offline mode for the driver's actual use case: he can see where to go and what he is carrying. He never needed to edit manifests in a tunnel.

My take: put read-only on the table tomorrow as "offline mode, phase 1", get the renewal signed, and full offline stays on the v3.1 roadmap where it already lives. Tomás, a rough build for demo: yes, Jonas can have something demo-able in about a week.

Cheers, Dev
